hydrology.catchment_type: Noyyal River basin urban wetland system
hydrology.regulatory_classification: CPCB Class C (Freshwater Fish Culture and Wildlife Propagation)
hydrology.volume_note: area x mean depth. A quoted 1.98M m^3 figure in circulation is internally inconsistent with area x depth by ~3.8x and is not used.

primary_sources: Tamil Nadu Pollution Control Board (TNPCB) - NWMP Monitoring Stations
Coimbatore City Municipal Corporation (CCMC) Smart City Periyakulam Rejuvenation DPR
Peer-reviewed environmental studies (Orient. J. Chem., J. Mater. Environ. Sci., Horizon e-Pub)
provenance.status: Compiled secondary benchmarks — field verification pending
provenance.scope_note: Water-quality parameters are literature/survey compilations used for vetting and display. They are NOT consumed by the simulation: the ecological model integrates its own mass-conserving budget from first principles (see src/models/ecology.py). pH 8.50 and mean DO 4.49 are survey benchmarks; the model is not fitted to them.

ph.seasonal_notes: Alkaline tendency driven by algal photosynthesis and domestic runoff influx

biochemical_oxygen_demand_bod_mg_l.assessment: High organic load due to upstream inlet channels

floating_solar_ecological_constraints.statutory_authority: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE) / TNPCB Environmental Guidelines
floating_solar_ecological_constraints.rationale: Prevents photic zone extinction, preserves light penetration for phytoplankton, limits severe dissolved oxygen deficits below 4.0 mg/L
